SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

602/37.
File No. 15-9-37.

Louza Station, 982
REPORT
Date September 15, 1937

Subject Chinese "National Salvation" Propaganda Travelling Group.

Made by C.D.I. Sharman Forwarded by Chief Inspector.

Sir,
With reference to Special Branch Report dated 13-9-37 on the subject of "Chinese National Salvation Propaganda Travelling Group", C.D.S.57 visited Room 16 of the Yah Tung (亞東) Hotel, 618 Canton Road at 5.30 p.m. 14-9-37 when he interviewed Wen Hai Tao (文海濤) and Chien Chow Ping (錢舟萍), the 2nd and 3rd named person mentioned on the report and learned that the above Group rented and occupied Room 9 of the Yah Tung Hotel on 7-9-37 and on 13-9-37 they transferred to Room 16. The object of having a room in the hotel is only to await the recognition on the registration of this organization with the Local Kuo-ming-tang Party and the Bureau of Social Affairs. The Group will leave for Nanking where they will start their work first as soon as the afore-mentioned procedure of registration has been completed with. The C.D.S. was definitely assured that the Group will not function in Shanghai.

C.D.S.57 has been detailed to visit the Hotel frequently and keep observation for meetings or other developments.

C.D.I.

D.D.O. "A" Div.

报告
日期：1937年9月15日

事由：中国“救亡”宣传旅行团。

由刑事侦缉督察 Sharman 呈报，经总督察转呈。

敬启者：
关于1937年9月13日有关“中国救亡宣传旅行团”一事之特务科报告，刑事侦缉警士57号于1937年9月14日下午5时30分前往广东路618号亚东（Yah Tung）旅馆16室，会见了报告中列名第二及第三位的文海濤（Wen Hai Tao）和錢舟萍（Chien Chow Ping），获悉上述团体于1937年9月7日租用并入住亚东旅馆9室，并于1937年9月13日迁至16室。在旅馆租房之目的，仅在于等待该组织在当地国民党党部及社会局完成注册备案。一旦上述注册手续办理完毕，该团即启程前往南京，并首先在那里开展工作。刑事侦缉警士得到明确保证，该团不会在上海开展活动。

已指派刑事侦缉警士57号经常前往该旅馆视察，监视其集会或其他动态。

刑事侦缉督察。

“A”分区副督察。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
                             S.1, Special Branch...X80002
REPORT                       Date September 13, 37.

Subject.........Chinese "National Salvation" Propaganda Travelling Group
..................- New body formed.
Made by...D.S.I....Kao Yen-ken......Forwarded by...C. Crawford J J

        A new organization entitled the "Chinese 'National
Salvation' Propaganda Travelling Group" (中國救亡旅行宣傳隊),
has come into existence with a temporary office in Room 9,
Yah Tung (亞東) Hotel, 618 Canton Road (Louza District).
The object of this Group is to carry out propaganda work in
favour of the national salvation movement among people in
inland places, including the provinces of Honan, Shantung
and Hopei.

        This group has been formed by eight students with
the following three in charge :-
    Ma Ying-chih    (馬英傑), ex-student of the Tsing
        Hwa University, Peiping.
    Wen Chi-tao     (文繼濤), ex-student of the Peking
        University, Peiping.
    Chien Chow-ping (錢舟萍), ex-student of the Fuhtan
        University, Shanghai.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / 14 SEP. 1937 / (CRIME DEPT.)）

        Those people are occupying a room in the above hotel
temporarily.

        The Group claims to have the financial support of
Madame Sun Yat-sen. It is at present applying for permission
from the Chinese Government and Kuomintang Authorities for
registration and sanction to operate. It is expected that
they will leave Shanghai and commence their work in inland
places in about one week's time.

        The propaganda work will be in the form of stage
plays, lectures and distributing of printed matter. The
Group has prepared a manifesto (copy attached), which calls
the attention of the people to the Japanese aggression of
China and her plan to exterminate the Chinese race and urges
the populace to continue their efforts towards driving the

报告                       日期：1937年9月13日。

事由 ____ 中国“救亡”宣传旅行团
 ____ - 新成立之团体。
制作人...副巡长 ____ 高彦根（Kao Yen-ken）____ 转呈人...C. Crawford J J

        一个名为“中国‘救亡’宣传旅行团”（中國救亡旅行宣傳隊）的新组织已经成立，其临时办事处设在老闸区广东路618号亚东（Yah Tung）旅馆9室。该团之宗旨是在内地民众中开展有利于救国运动的宣传工作，范围包括河南、山东及河北等省。

        该团由八名学生组成，由以下三人负责：
    馬英傑（Ma Ying-chih），前北平清华大学学生。
    文繼濤（Wen Chi-tao），前北平北京大学学生。
    錢舟萍（Chien Chow-ping），前上海复旦大学学生。

（印：副总监 / 1937年9月14日 / （刑事处））

        这些人暂时占用上述旅馆的一间客房。

        该团声称获得孙逸仙夫人（宋庆龄）的财政支持。目前正向中国政府及国民党当局申请注册及运营许可。预计他们将在约一周后离开上海，开始在内地的工作。
